body_markdown:
# Introduction

Vocabulary revision is most useful when you learn words in context and use them in your own sentences. This lesson reviews everyday, workplace, travel and descriptive vocabulary.

## 1. Everyday words

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| arrange | put things in order or make a plan |
| borrow | take something temporarily and return it |
| repair | fix something damaged |
| improve | make something better |
| prepare | get ready |

## 2. Workplace words

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| responsibility | a duty you must handle |
| schedule | a plan of times and activities |
| confirm | make sure something is correct |
| report | give information about something |
| assist | help someone |

## 3. Useful descriptive words

- reliable: can be trusted
- careful: paying attention to avoid mistakes
- crowded: full of people
- urgent: needing quick attention
- available: ready to be used

## 4. Choose the correct word

1. Please ___ the appointment. (confirm / borrow)
2. The room is very ___. (crowded / repair)
3. I need to ___ this broken chair. (repair / schedule)
4. She is a ___ employee. (reliable / urgently)
5. Safety is everyone's ___. (responsibility / available)

## Answers

1. confirm 2. crowded 3. repair 4. reliable 5. responsibility.

## 5. Use new words

Write one sentence each using: prepare, assist, urgent, improve and schedule.

## 6. Speaking revision

Speak for one minute about your work or daily routine. Try to use at least five words from this lesson. Do not force words into a sentence if they do not fit.

## Memory tip

Review new words after one day, one week and one month. Keep a small notebook with the word, meaning and your own example sentence.
